name: EMERGENCY_VEHICLES_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W5-SA70. Not to be used at fire or ambulance stations (sheet note). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). W5-SA70B illustrated (C 900). Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): EMERGENCY 100 C, baseline +2 from the horizontal centre line (top 432), ink 647 (measured 646, centred); VEHICLES 100 C, baseline +152 from the horizontal centre line (top 582), ink 516 (measured 515, x 264-779).
